items.text: Broncos officially placed RB R.J. Harvey on short-term IR after knee injury in Thursday practice. Will miss next four games, eligible to return Dec. 6 vs Dolphins.
items.why: Knee injury suffered in practice; short-term IR designation confirmed by Schefter and Rapoport.
items.implication: Misses at least Weeks 8-11; DEN backfield thins further with Badie already on IR.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/targets for JK Dobbins and remaining backs; 3-6 extra targets freed in passing game per Levitan.

items.text: Patriots downgraded WR A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) and RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness) to OUT vs Dolphins. Brown had flared knee issue after recent return.
items.why: Missed practices Thu/Fri; Brown knee flare + ankle; Henderson illness. Corroborated by Schefter.
items.implication: NE receiving corps thins to Douglas/Chism/Williams; RB depth to Stevenson/Kiner.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining NE WRs; Stevenson workload bump.

items.text: Seahawks RBs Jadarian Price and Zach Charbonnet have no injury designations and both expected to play MNF vs Bears. Charbonnet season debut; backfield whole.
items.why: No game status per beat and Rapoport/Schefter; full clearance.
items.implication: Crowded SEA backfield; sit everyone or committee caution per some analysts.
items.opportunity: Shared carries; monitor snap distribution for Price vs Charbonnet.
items.conflict: Derek Brown Primer: sit SEA backfield.

items.text: Shocked Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) not on final injury report and is IN/expected to play SNF vs Commanders despite recent issues and limited snaps last week. Hard to believe 100%.
items.why: No designation after limited Friday practice; Levitan notes surprise given prior hamstring/back.
items.implication: Still startable but workload risk; Dameon Pierce on IR removes handcuff.
items.opportunity: If limited, elevated chance for backups like Elijah Mitchell (elevated).
items.conflict: Berry has Barkley on HATE list citing usage concerns.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) is IN and off final report after missing three games, but ETR has smallish docks on his rushing volume due to lingering pain on cuts/sprints.
items.why: Confirmed return; practice full enough; docks for residual ankle effects.
items.implication: Must-start QB but rushing upside tempered; unlocks Ravens pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers and Ravens weapons see full volume boost.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) remains QUESTIONABLE with limited practices all week and cryptic tweets; trade rumors circulating. Was close last week but another Q tag.
items.why: Third straight limited; coach notes; Levitan flags uncertainty and rumors.
items.implication: If out, Braelon Allen full work; if in, timeshare likely.
items.opportunity: Allen retains value either way; Hall ramp-up risk.
items.conflict: Berry loves both Hall and Allen vs LV.

items.text: RJ Harvey's role so unique no clean handcuff/replacement exists, but his OUT/IR frees 3-6 targets. Jaylen Waddle also Q (chest).
items.why: Unique receiving role for Harvey; targets now available in DEN offense.
items.implication: Pass-game opportunity for Waddle (if active) or other Broncos.
items.opportunity: Monitor Waddle status closely; DEN RBs for volume.
items.conflict: Berry HATE on Waddle vs KC secondary.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka ruled OUT (foot) for Bucs vs Falcons after clearing concussion but remaining sidelined. Projections updated for absence.
items.why: Foot injury post-concussion protocol; confirmed on final reports and ETR board.
items.implication: TB WR targets redistribute; Godwin/Irving upside rises.
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/route share for remaining Bucs pass-catchers and Bucky Irving.

items.text: Titans WR Carnell Tate (shoulder) and RB Tyjae Spears (knee) both OUT vs Bengals. Tate had been on breakout trajectory with high targets.
items.why: Official OUT designations; ETR board and multiple injury reports.
items.implication: TEN offense loses key pieces; Ridley Q but optimistic.
items.opportunity: Target bump for Calvin Ridley and remaining Titans skill players.

items.text: Weird Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) Q coming off bye LP-LP-DNP. Given that and BTJ situation, perhaps season-high routes for Travis Hunter.
items.why: Meyers practice pattern odd; Hunter opportunity expands.
items.implication: Hunter route/target spike potential vs IND.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Hunter if Meyers limited/out.

items.text: Zay Flowers LOVE as WR5 vs BUF; Lamar return unlocks track-meet environment and Flowers getting fed in right spots.
items.why: Bills-Ravens shootout potential; Flowers volume with Lamar back.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 play in favorable script.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle HATE (WR30) vs KC; production lacking and Chiefs allow just one WR TD all season (to JSN).
items.why: Tough KC secondary; poor recent production; also Q with chest.
items.conflict: Levitan notes possible target bump from Harvey OUT.

items.text: Derrick Henry LOVE (RB6) @ BUF; history vs Bills and defenses that can't stop run this week.
items.why: Favorable run matchups league-wide; Henry specific history.
items.implication: Strong RB1 play with Lamar back.

items.text: Chase Brown LOVE (RB8) vs TEN and Josh Jacobs LOVE (RB11) vs CAR; both face run-soft defenses, Brown due TD luck, Jacobs gets nightmare matchup for backs.
items.implication: Start with confidence; note Jacobs off-field allegations under NFL review (Schefter).

items.text: Saquon Barkley HATE (RB20) @ WSH on usage concerns post-injury; Omarion Hampton HATE (RB34) @ LAR still lacking real role; Tony Pollard HATE (RB21) brutal underdog spot.
items.why: Barkley workload risk; Hampton role; Pollard game script.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Saquon surprising IN but not 100%.

items.text: Joe Burrow LOVE (QB2) vs TEN and Trevor Lawrence LOVE (QB4) vs IND; high-scoring environments vs pass-soft defenses.
items.why: Huge team totals and favorable matchups.

items.text: Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG in two games since Caleb Williams return; leads TEs in utilization, top-5 finishes both weeks.
items.why: Sustained high target share post-Williams return.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins set season lows in snap rate (51.5%) and target share (3%) with Dylan Sampson back from IR; prior without Sampson averaged 13.6% targets. Role hit in passing game.
items.why: Sampson return compresses Judkins receiving role while he keeps majority touches.
items.implication: Floor lowered; still lead back but less upside.
